Read root `AGENTS.md` and `docs/README.md` before changing Rockwood Projects. Follow the nearest folder's `AGENTS.md`; use the linked product, architecture and operations guides. Keep public showcase data isolated from the authenticated workspace. Preserve source rows, workflow gates, versions and audit. For live data actions, follow `agents/README.md` and use the shared authenticated API. Repository access alone grants no live credentials or outgoing-message authority.
